name: GP prediction-error model
description: Empirical SGP4 prediction error by orbit regime and prediction age, in RTN. Element sets are propagated to later element sets of the same object (consecutive-set differences, which are not truth) or to independent reference states (GCRF, from analysis/reference-states). Batches accumulate counts, moments and histograms; finalize gives mean, covariance, quantiles, robust sigma and clipped covariance per stratum. With a model on accumulate (reference mode), each error is also tested against its stratum's model covariance (Mahalanobis d^2 against chi-square with 3 degrees of freedom, every sample counted) and finalize gates each stratum CALIBRATED, FAILED or INSUFFICIENT; scale_model fits per-stratum scale factors to reference-state errors. screening_evaluation scores a probabilistic (Foster Pc), a bounded-set and a possibility (admissible-set) screening rule on independent cases built from reference-state errors with synthetic true misses. screening_cases scores the same rules on caller-supplied pairs, each object with its own covariance. common_epoch propagates element sets of one object to common epochs and returns each one's RTN difference from an origin there (a reference state, their mean, or one set). map_covariance maps an RTN covariance through a state transition matrix: SGP4's (central differences in nonsingular mean elements), two-body (complex-step Kepler) or the Lambert arc of Thompson et al. (2019). hpop_arcs and hpop_coverage calibrate HPOP covariance (P0 at the element-set epoch, white-acceleration process noise) against reference states.

sequentialJustification.detail: Deterministic SGP4 propagation and statistics over caller-supplied element sets and reference states. No host calls, threads or network access; batches are combined through the prior accumulator.

Reference states ($OEM, GCRF, UTC, OBJECT.NORAD_CAT_ID): the origin of targets whose origin is reference, and the instant of any target with afterSeconds (the first reference epoch at or after its epoch). The first copy of an epoch, in input order, is used.

wildcardJustification.detail: Per target: its epoch, the origin state (GCRF, km, km/s) and per element set its epoch, age in days and prediction minus origin in the origin's RTN axes.
